title: Adurite
body:
Description

Adurite can spawn in Lightslate, Beigeslate, Darkslate, Lavaslate, Blackstone, and Blueslate nodes.

Its refined variant uses a legacy Granite Roblox texture. Its forged variant uses a legacy Mud Roblox texture. All states of Adurite seem to be a deeper red color.

Putting raw Adurite in a refinery raises the sell value to $100/stud. Putting refined Adurite through a forge further increases the value to $200/stud.

Like every other material in the game, you can use refined and forged Adurite to complete Schematics.

Trivia

  • Due to an incorrect translation string, it took the name of Mythril for some time.
  • You can find Adurite in both Finlay and Ferwater.
  • Mythril and Adurite have the exact same texture, only the ores of both have different textures.
  • Adurite can easily be missed in Lavaslate since it nearly matches the color of Lavaslate.

Fun facts

  • Many quest items use Adurite in their name, but not as a key component, such as the Adurite key or Emberbane.
